models_evaluated: AI-based malaria clinical decision-support system (AI-CDSS; underlying model unspecified)

links.outcome: Physician knowledge and questionnaire-assessed adherence to malaria case-management guidelines
links.effect: AI-CDSS plus targeted training increased mean compliance from 50.7% (95% CI: 42-59) to 96.8% (95% CI: 92-100, p<0.001); the independent effect of training was not isolated.
links.quote: Mean compliance increased from 50.7% (95% CI: 42-59) to 96.8% (95% CI: 92-100, p<0.001).

unlisted_practices: Using protocol-aligned AI clinical decision support and prompts to improve physicians' adherence to national malaria management guidelines.

links.quote: A combination of an AI-driven CDSS and focused training demonstrated a substantial improvement in physician compliance with the 2023 Sudan Malaria Case Management Protocol, particularly in critical care aspects.
